title: DUSTLINE FIELD UPDATE 0.3.0
summary: Operative accounts, durable progression on Fly Postgres, and a fix for the combat trace crash.
notes: Added operative accounts: sign up, sign in, and session restore in the menu.
Progression (XP, stats, loadouts) now persists across redeploys via Fly Postgres.
Match results are written to your account after every match.
Fixed a combat crash when a shot missed its target.
Client now runs on PCFShadowMap for the modern Three.js renderer.
